138897: Sumireko Sanshokuin is one of the three initial heroines introduced in the series. Her nickname, Pansy, is a wordplay from her full name 三色院菫子. When the 院 and 子 removed, the remaining character (三色菫) form the Japanese name for Viola tricolor or Wild Pansy flower.
138898: Aoi Hinata is a second year high school student and is also the ace of the school's Tennis Club.
138899: Sakura Akino is a third-year high school student and the Student Council President who is in love with Taiyo Oga.
138900: Amatsuyu Kisaragi, nicknamed Joro (如雨露 Jōro )is a second year High School student and the Student Council secretary (being replaced during the Confession Arc) who is the object of affection of Sumireko Sanshokuin, Sakura Akino, Aoi Hinata, Asaka Mayama and Hina Hanetachi.
138901: Taiyou Ooga is a second year High School student and the ace of the school Baseball Club. He is in love with Sumireko Sanshokuin and was once the target of affection of Aoi Hinata and Sakura Akino.
149583: She is a second year student in High School and a member of the school Newspaper Club who is in love with Amatsuyu Kisaragi.
152048: Youki Chiharu is the newest transfer student in Amatsuyu Kisaragi's class.
152053: She is a childhood friend of Hose and a second-year student at Karashobu High School. In stark contrast to Cherry, who is always by her side, she is a very quiet and mysterious girl.
